column1: Data Preparation Checklist
1. What type of public data structure will be used to generate synthetic data ?
2. Are there sensitive attributes in the dataset ?
a. If yes, what are they ?
3. How the statistical properties of the synthetic data structure is maintained ?
4. How the quality of the generated synthetic data structure is maintained ?
5. What are the dependencies or relationships between the variables that needs to be preserved ?
6. What are the domain-specific contraints on synthetic data on HIV-prEP level ?
7. How will the missing data will be handled ?
8. What is the expected size of the missing data?
9. How many versions of the synthetic data will be generated ?
Anonymization Class 1 Checklist (Basic Anonymization)
1. What are the key anonymization benchmarks ? (e.g., k-Anonymity, l-Diversity, t-Closeness)
2. What attributes need k-anonymization and what is k-value ?
3. Which identifiers undergo pseudonymizations ?
4. What the numerical attributes that require random shuffling ?
6. How much generalization will be applied to categorical variables ?
7. Will supression be applied to constant or highly sensitive variables ?
8. How will the effectiveness of these anonymization techniques be evaluated ?
9. What are the expected computational overhead of these techniques ?
Anonymization Class 2 Checklist (Intermediate Anonymization Techniques)
1.  Which attributes need top-bottom coding ?
2. Are there extreme values that should be truncated to prevent identification ?
3. Will microaggregation be applied to numerical data? If so what group size should be used?
4. Are there continuous attributes that need bucketing ?
5. Are text fields being masked or reduced to remove identifiable information ?
6. Will noise addition (data perturbation) be applied to numerical attributes ?
7. Which columns need data swapping, what are the contraints on swaps ?
8. How will the correlations be preserved when performing anonymization ?
9. How will the re-identification risk be measured post-anonymization ?
10. What is the impact of these techniques on data utility and variance retention ?
Anonymization Class 3 Checklist (Advanced)
1. Will differential privacy be implemented ?
a. If yes, what will be the epsilon (?) value ?
2. Will homomorphic encryption be used for computation on encrpted data ?
3. What level of encrption overhead is expected in homomorphic encrption ?
4. Are anonymized queries subject to noise injection for additional privacy ?
5. What are the trade-off between privacy and accuracy for these advanced techniques ?
6. How will adversarial testing be performed against differential privacy models ?
7. What are compliance requirements can you find and does these technique fit into it ?
Performanace and Evaluation Checklist
1. How good these techniques fit for the HIV-prEP pipeline ?
2. What are the metrics used to measure anonymization effectiveness ?
3. How will you benchmark different anonymization strategies ?
4. How will information loss be quantified due to anonymization ?
5. How will memory and processing time be monitored for anonymization steps ?
6. How will false positives/negatives will be handled in privacy risk assessments ?
7. What are the visualizations availbale to assess anonymization impact on distributions ?
